description: Indicator Summary Data: Change in Size of Glaciers in BC (1985-2005) is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Climate Action Secretariat. This tabular data set contains the result of an analysis supporting the indicator 'Change in Size of Glaciers in B.C. (1985-2005)' published in Indicators of Climate Change in British Columbia (2015-16 Update) and by Environmental Reporting BC. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Climate Action Secretariat. Its tags are climate change, environmental reporting, glacier, ice coverage, indicator. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2018-07-12 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
